content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Plugins online

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a complete stack of tools that lets you sell digital products directly, without intermediaries. It’s built on open protocols and decentralized systems. You host your product. You verify payments. You deliver files. No third party can shut you down. No platform can freeze your funds. This is not a plugin or a service. It’s architecture. It’s ownership. It’s control. For creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and beyond, this is not optional. It’s necessary. Stripe, PayPal, and others exclude entire regions based on risk models that ignore your reality. Sovereign infrastructure is your response. It’s how you take back the tools of commerce.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack is simple but robust. First, your plugin is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. These are free, global, and immutable. Second, backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These handle order processing and payment verification. Third, order data is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. This is your ledger. Fourth, file delivery happens via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. These are secure and fast. Finally, payments are verified on-chain using NOWPayments. This supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer accounts. The webhook fires the moment payment confirms. Your customer gets their plugin instantly. You get paid directly. No middlemen.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators who sell plugins, templates, presets, or software but cannot access conventional payment processors. If Stripe rejected your application, this is for you. If PayPal suspended your account, this is for you. If Gumroad flagged your country, this is for you. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent their infrastructure. You’re not a tenant. You’re an owner. This stack is pressure-tested in regions with actual currency collapse, payment rejection, and financial isolation. It’s not theoretical. It’s operational. It’s built in Zimbabwe. It works in Nigeria. It works in Venezuela. It works anywhere.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure is ownership, not renting.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost, and sovereignty. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your plugin’s landing page. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver the plugin file. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments. These tools are free or low-cost. They’re open. They’re global. They’re yours. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture for you in 48 hours. It includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email deliverability. It’s end-to-end tested. It’s ready to sell. You own it the moment it’s deployed.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by mapping your requirements. How many products will you sell? What networks will you accept? Will you use BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees? Next, choose your stack. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is for three products. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is for five. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) gives you the docs and code. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes everything. Deploy manually or let COREMERCH handle it. Once deployed, load your products. Test the flow. Go live. Your customers pay in crypto. You deliver the plugin. No platforms. No subscriptions. No gatekeepers. This is how you sell plugins without Stripe. This is how you build sovereign commerce.

It uses open protocols, decentralized systems, and crypto payments to give you full ownership and control over your commerce. For creators in excluded regions, it’s a structural alternative to rented platforms.
Stripe’s exclusion is structural. Your response must be architectural.

If you’re ready to deploy sovereign commerce infrastructure today, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is your solution. It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours. Five products loaded. SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured. End-to-end tested. Own your infrastructure. Sell your plugins. No gatekeepers.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). 2. Decide on accepted networks: BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees. 3. Provide product details: name, description, price. 4. Deploy manually or let COREMERCH handle it. 5. Test the payment flow with a test transaction. 6. Load your products into the system. 7. Configure email deliverability with SPF/DKIM/DMARC. 8. Go live and start selling. 9. Monitor orders via Supabase or Google Sheets. 10. Deliver plugins automatically via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is deployed for you in 48 hours. No coding required. You own it after deployment.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to pay monthly fees?
No. This is not a subscription. You own the infrastructure after deployment. No recurring fees.
How are plugins delivered to customers?
Plugins are delivered automatically via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 once payment is verified on-chain.
What if I need support after deployment?
All stacks include 30-day support. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) includes full documentation and source code.
